---
title: "Google Scholar Search Figures"
author: "Kate Shutta"
date: "2026-06-23"
output: html_document
---

Read in the data from the Publish or Perish output. See the manuscript for details.

```{R}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
dat = read.table("../ipop_data_analysis/nonlinear_aging_data/pop_output_annotated.txt",
                 sep="\t",header=T) %>%
    filter(Cites.Lehallier.2019 != "No",
         Cites.Lehallier.2019 != "Omit (not in English)") 
dat$Year[dat$Year == "2026"] = "2026*"
dat$Year = factor(dat$Year)
```


```{R}
dat %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=Year)) + geom_bar() + 
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_text(
    stat = "count", 
    aes(label = after_stat(count)), 
    vjust = -0.5
  ) +
  xlab("Year") +
  ylab("Number of Search Query Results")
ggsave(file="literature_search_timeline.jpeg",width=6,height=4)
```
```{R}
dim(dat)
sum(dat$Cites)
```
